standard: At least one concrete nontrivial operational transformation, persistence operation, protocol parser/serializer, runtime integration, or executable harness with real source and an existing reproducible behavioral check. Folder presence, compilation, value types, gate/denial-only code, simulated peers and labels do not qualify. This is a reviewed lower bound on testable subsets, never full module acceptance. Test existence is not proof its complete feature works.
